cd80_ci_index_member.name: cd80_ci_index_member
cd80_ci_index_member.description: Extract Shenwan industry constituents by three-level classification. It can provide all constituents of a certain classification, or retrieve the classification a stock belongs to by stock code, with flexible parameters.

cd80_stock_refer_holders_top10.name: cd80_stock_refer_holders_top10
cd80_stock_refer_holders_top10.description: Top ten shareholders data of listed companies.

cd80_bond_cb_redeem.name: cd80_bond_cb_redeem
cd80_bond_cb_redeem.description: Information such as maturity redemption and mandatory redemption of convertible bonds.

cd80_index_dd.name: cd80_index_dd
cd80_index_dd.description: Daily market data for various indices.

cd80_daily.name: cd80_daily
cd80_daily.description: Daily stock market data, including security codes, trading dates, open, high, low and close prices, price changes, trading volumes, and trading amounts.

cd80_daily_basic.name: cd80_daily_basic
cd80_daily_basic.description: Daily fundamental and market indicators for all stocks, including valuation ratios, turnover rates, dividend yields, share capital, and market capitalization.

cd80_factor_list.name: cd80_factor_list
cd80_factor_list.description: Quantitative investment factor catalog data, including factor names, applicable asset classes, factor categories, factor definitions, and mathematical calculation logic.

cd80_fund_portfolio.name: cd80_fund_portfolio
cd80_fund_portfolio.description: Public fund equity portfolio holdings data, including fund codes, announcement dates, reporting-period end dates, held securities, holding market values and quantities, and relevant holding ratios.

cd80_anns_d.name: cd80_anns_d
cd80_anns_d.description: Listed-company announcement metadata, including announcement date, security ticker, security name, announcement title, and source document URL.

cd80_cb_price_chg.name: cd80_cb_price_chg
cd80_cb_price_chg.description: Convertible bond conversion price change data, including bond ticker, bond name, publication date, effective change date, and conversion prices before and after each adjustment.
